objective: Independently audit current-state prefix carry, fixed-rewrite depth obstructions, shifted-correction DAG collisions, the conditional all-prefix geodesic reduction, and positive-cycle event constraints.

quantifiers: fixed distinct literal coalescent word relations on actual nonperiodic positive orbits
all tail paths and collisions through the declared DAG depth
every permanent-safe renewal boundary and every positive integral cycle
exact_scope.completeness: Bounded exact enumeration audits conventions and finds obstructions; all-scale statements require written proofs. No finite exhaustion of H112, H72 or cycles is asserted.

arithmetic.floating_point_role: none; integer powers, rational inequalities, and symbolic limiting arguments only

verifier_reconstructs: tail collisions by full binary enumeration
safe maximum-weight competitors and ordinary source residues
state-form carries and exact macro inequalities
renewal binomial capacities and rational entropy certificates
cycle event identities and retained adversarial obstructions

stop_conditions: Repair or refute missing quantifiers before accepting a theorem.
Do not confuse affine divisibility with legal positive safe descent.
Do not infer extinction or global confluence from a finite DAG.
Do not promote H112 or X02 to an internally verified theorem.
interpretation_boundary: Fixed-dictionary direct-lift extinction does not forbid all uses or compositions of finitely many rules.
Maximum-weight and safe maximum-weight paths must be distinguished.
The H112 reduction is conditional and cycles remain separate.
